config_a.name: cardiac_quadratic_g005_l1_r0_q6_v1
config_a.scope: Prospective800-step P2 convergence controls on the two existing validation geometries and their fixed different loading histories. Entire trajectories start from zero histories on both mesh levels; same passive law, P1 fibers, solver, pressure waveform and timestep. These are validation inputs, never calibration/test selection. Generate coarse reference first, then fine reference, independent native norms and whole-element positivity. Completed numerical sensitivity does not imply passing1%. Frozen neural models remain unchanged; geometry/template-specific convergence does not establish anatomical validity.
